ADDED i1: Reproduces JIRA issue TEXT-178: interpolation of a template whose delimiters are nested and overlapping in a "weird" way.

For the template {@code $${${a}}} t
ADDED i2: Template using nested/escaped delimiters that exercise the boundary parsing.
ADDED i3: Expected interpolation result: inner {@code ${a}} becomes {@code 1}.
ADDED i4: Variable bindings shared by every assertion in a test.
ADDED i7: Asserts that interpolating {@code template} yields {@code expected} for every input type {@link StringSubstitutor} accepts, plus the in-place {@code replaceIn}
ADDED i8: replace(...) overloads: each accepts a different source type but returns a new String.
ADDED i9: replace(Object) uses the argument's toString(), here the raw template.
ADDED i10: replaceIn(...) overloads: mutate the buffer in place and report whether any substitution occurred (true here, since ${a} is resolved).
